response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pairs), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_type_avg FROM scored WHERE share > avg_share GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: The trader type's average share is the simple (unweighted) mean of the shares across all of that type's (translink, trader type) pairs, computed before filtering.
Records are linked by inner joins, so records with no matching transaction or trader are dropped. Trader type is trader.tradekind.
Trader types with no pair above the average share (for example, when all shares are equal) return no row.
